prompt: A 70-year-old man presents after a TIA. His BP is 150/95, he had unilateral weakness lasting 40 minutes, and no diabetes. What is his ABCD2 score and risk?

rubric_items.text: States the ABCD2 score is 5 (exact integer match required).

States that an ABCD2 score of 5 indicates moderate/intermediate stroke risk (any correctly time-qualified estimate acceptable, e.g. approximately 4.1% at 2 days or 5.9% at 7 days; no specific time horizon required).
